import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductRetraction

/-!
# Degree-zero cohomology of a circle product

The initial Mayer--Vietoris restriction is injective. Since both of its chart
coordinates are the first-factor retraction, that retraction and projection
pullback are inverse in degree zero.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- In degree zero, pulling back the chart retraction recovers the global class. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyRetraction_right_inverse_zero (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    Function.RightInverse (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0)
      (circleProductCohomologyPullback X 0) := by
  let r := singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
    (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) 0
  let e := biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v 0)
    (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) 0)
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hcover⟩ := circleProductChart_open_cover X v
  letI : Mono r := singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_mono_zero
    (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
    hU hV hcover
  have hleft : ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyPullback X 0) ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0) = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    exact circleProductCohomologyRetraction_left_inverse X v 0
  have hdiag : r ≫ e.inv =
      biprod.lift (ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0))
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0)) :=
    circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction X v 0
  have hright : ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0) ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (circleProductCohomologyPullback X 0) = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply (cancel_mono (r ≫ e.inv)).mp
    rw [hdiag]
    apply biprod.hom_ext <;> simp [Category.assoc, hleft]
  intro c
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hright c

/-- Projection onto the first factor induces the inverse of this equivalence on
degree-zero integral singular cohomology. -/
def circleProductCohomologyZeroEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 0 ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology X 0 :=
  { circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0 with
    invFun := circleProductCohomologyPullback X 0
    left_inv := circleProductCohomologyRetraction_right_inverse_zero X v
    right_inv := circleProductCohomologyRetraction_left_inverse X v 0 }

@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyZeroEquiv_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) 0) :
    circleProductCohomologyZeroEquiv X v c = circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v 0 c :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyZeroEquiv_symm_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology X 0) :
    (circleProductCohomologyZeroEquiv X v).symm c = circleProductCohomologyPullback X 0 c :=
  rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
